verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents 'Creating custom rules' for transaction categorization, which suggests rules that apply automatically as transactions arrive. It also says busywork tasks are 'described once, done automatically, reviewed by you,' implying event-driven automation scoped to bookkeeping. The rules doc is only a title, though, and nothing shows general-purpose event triggers or configurable actions beyond categorization. Missing for 10: documented rule conditions and actions, triggers beyond transaction categorization (e.g., webhooks or other event types), details on how natural-language automations are defined and triggered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
